audit_definition.delta_w_relative_shift: ||concat(B_merge A_merge - B_endpoint A_endpoint)||_2 / ||concat(B_endpoint A_endpoint)||_2; 24 Q/V matrices
audit_definition.statistics_scope: 10 stages of one seed per arm, not ten independent seeds
audit_definition.profile_tolerance: max/blocks/numel exact; trace and mean rtol5e-7 for float32 log reduction; factors exact against saved checkpoints

source_evidence.interpretation: _capture_endpoint_posterior_state invokes an additional Fisher pass and restores model mode/gradients, not RNG; _compute_delta_fisher later recomputes at retained factors. This snapshot corroborates runtime logs; exact historical working-tree hash remains unavailable.

limits: Baseline has both damping and fusion removed; it is not an isolated fusion-effect accuracy control.
Endpoint and retained Fisher use separate stochastic passes without matched sampler/transforms/RNG, so their difference includes estimator repeat noise.
No per-snapshot path factors are saved in these archives: cannot reconstruct exact intra-path B@A cross terms.
Historical diagnostics add Fisher/anchor/future passes and can alter RNG trajectories; these accuracy results cannot replace current native S3 exact-protocol arms.
